title.zh: 01 可靠性本质：不是出厂能亮就够了
title.en: 01 Reliability: working at shipment is not enough

subtitle.zh: Mission Profile / 时间 / 应力 / 失效概率
subtitle.en: Mission profile / time / stress / failure probability

body.zh: 品质：回答“现在是否合格”
可靠性：回答“在规定条件与时间内能否持续工作”
body.en: Reliability: can it keep working under specified conditions for the required time?

body.zh: • 基于当前样品的检验与测试
body.en: • Inspection and testing of current samples

body.zh: • 聚焦规格与功能是否满足
body.en: • Focus on meeting specifications and functions

body.zh: • 基于时间、应力与环境的持续行为
body.en: • Continuing behavior over time, stress and environment

body.zh: • 关注失效概率与寿命分布
body.en: • Focus on failure probability and lifetime distribution

body.zh: • 结果是：合格 / 不合格
• 结果是：在给定条件下的
权衡：性能/功耗/面积/成本 ↔ 电学与热学可靠性余量
body.en: Trade-off: performance / power / area / cost ↔ electrical and thermal reliability margins

body.zh: 闭环：Inline → WAT → Stress Test → Field Return → FA
body.en: Closed loop: inline → WAT → stress test → field return → FA

body.zh: 结论：可靠性不是一次Pass，而是一段时间里的低失效概率。
body.en: Conclusion: reliability is low failure probability over time, beyond a single pass.

uncertain.explanation: Original visibly says 有害期; preserved, although random-failure useful-life terminology is normally different.
